description: A five-level employee hierarchy in the Svelte 5 data grid, from CEO to VPs, directors, managers and individual contributors. The first column is a cell snippet that indents by depth, draws connector lines between parents and children and rotates a chevron on expand; the other columns are regular grid columns with a role pill, department, a headcount roll-up summed from descendants and tenure. The pattern is a flat array plus an expanded map, with the visible rows derived.

faq.question: How is the tree rendered?
faq.answer: The rows stay a flat array with a depth and a parent id. A $derived filters it to the rows whose ancestors are all expanded, and that list is passed as data; the name column's snippet draws the indent and the chevron from the depth.

faq.question: How is headcount rolled up?
faq.answer: A pass over the flat array counts descendants per node once, and the headcount column reads the result. Expand all and collapse all just replace the expanded map.

faq.question: Is there a built-in tree mode?
faq.answer: Yes. The treeData prop nests rows by parent id with an expander, indent and treegrid accessibility. This hand-built version is the option when you need custom connector lines and a rendering of your own.
